Dave Matthews Band
March 1, 2024
Dolby Live at MGM Grand - Las Vegas, NV

*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*
*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Rear Rail of Section 204, House Right of FOH, DFC, Mics PAS @ 8'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 7.11 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 24/48) > Audacity 3.4.2 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:

01. Intro
02. Virginia in the Rain¹
03. Old Dirt Hill (Bring That Beat Back)
04. Madman's Eyes
05. Looking for a Vein
06. Satellite
07. Will It Go Round in Circles²
08. Spaceman
09. Dave Speak: Protect Children
10. The Last Stop³
11. Lover Lay Down
12. Straight Shot
13. Dave Speak: Balding
14. Let's Dance⁴
15. Grey Street
16. The Space Between
17. Jimi Thing⁵
18. Cheap Sunglasses⁶
19. Gravedigger⁷
20. Why I Am
21. Warehouse⁸
22. Encore Break
23. Dave Speak: Hazel's Version
24. Pretty Bird⁹
25. Dancing Nancies

Set Time: [02:34:05.414]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ with extended Carter outro
² Billy Preston cover; first time played by DMB
³ truncated version, with "Immigrant Song" (Led Zeppelin) outro
⁴ David Bowie cover; first time played by DMB
⁵ with Rashawn "Dancing Machine" (The Jackson 5) interpolation
⁶ ZZ Top cover; first time played by DMB
⁷ with Carter solo intro
⁸ with improv intro & Louie Louie interpolation
⁹ Hazel Dickens cover; Dave Solo

Huge thanks to the entire DMB organization for supporting live taping.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.

Compiled on 2024/03/09.
